shots.prompt: 视角：定格特写。巨大的指尖接触到山贼和马匹的瞬间。铠甲凹陷，马身变形。物理法则在绝对力量面前失效。 重点：接触瞬间的毁灭性。 [山贼: ancient Chinese bandit, dirty leather armor, fierce facial expression, riding a horse, holding a rusty machete, motion blur, aggressive posture, villain, realistic miniature texture, cinematic lighting, macro photography] [微缩村庄: miniature ancient chinese village, thatched houses, yellow earth ground, chaos, dust, running figures, macro view, diorama style, realistic textures, cinematic lighting]
shots.dialogue: 旁白：凡胎肉体撞上了神明的一击，铠甲与骨骼在瞬间崩碎，连惨叫都来不及发出。
shots.audio_prompt: Frozen time shot, giant finger makes contact, armor crumples instantly, horse body deforms, shockwave ripples, extreme physics impact.

shots.prompt: 视角：跟拍镜头。山贼连人带马变成一颗炮弹，在空中划出一道残影，飞越了整个微缩村庄。 重点：夸张的位移。 [山贼: ancient Chinese bandit, dirty leather armor, fierce facial expression, riding a horse, holding a rusty machete, motion blur, aggressive posture, villain, realistic miniature texture, cinematic lighting, macro photography] [箱内空间: empty air inside box, motion blur background, depth of field, mid-air, cinematic action shot]
shots.dialogue: 旁白：那个刚才还耀武扬威的恶徒，此刻像一颗出膛的炮弹，划破长空，飞越了整个村庄。
shots.audio_prompt: Fast tracking shot, bandit becomes a blur, flying horizontally across the miniature landscape, camera struggles to keep up, wind effects.

shots.prompt: 视角：侧拍。山贼重重地撞在箱子的玻璃壁上。身体扭曲成不自然的形状，血雾在玻璃表面炸开。 重点：惨烈的物理反馈。 [山贼: ancient Chinese bandit, dirty leather armor, fierce facial expression, riding a horse, holding a rusty machete, motion blur, aggressive posture, villain, realistic miniature texture, cinematic lighting, macro photography] [箱壁边缘: glass wall of vivarium, sand accumulation at bottom, blood smear on glass surface, reflection, macro detail, grim atmosphere]
shots.dialogue: 旁白：随着一声闷响，他在世界的边缘——那层看不见的透明墙壁上，撞成了一滩烂泥。
shots.audio_prompt: Side shot, body slams into the glass wall of the tank, violent impact, blood splatters on the glass surface, body twists unnaturally.

shots.prompt: 视角：全景。玻璃上留下一道长长的血痕。扭曲的尸体滑落到箱子边缘的沙土中，一动不动。 重点：尘埃落定的死亡。 [山贼: ancient Chinese bandit, dirty leather armor, fierce facial expression, riding a horse, holding a rusty machete, motion blur, aggressive posture, villain, realistic miniature texture, cinematic lighting, macro photography] [箱壁边缘: glass wall of vivarium, sand accumulation at bottom, blood smear on glass surface, reflection, macro detail, grim atmosphere]
shots.dialogue: 旁白：只有玻璃上缓缓滑落的血痕，证明了刚才那个不可一世的生命曾经存在过。
shots.audio_prompt: Static wide shot, distorted corpse slides slowly down the glass wall leaving a red streak, dust settles, silence, heavy atmosphere.

shots.prompt: 视角：中景。李道玄猛地将手抽回，动作带着一丝惊慌。他坐在昏暗的房间里，呼吸急促。 重点：从干预中抽离，回到现实。 [李道玄: young Chinese man, tired expression, messy hair, casual home clothes, modern setting, cinematic lighting, blue screen light reflection on face, shocked expression, detailed facial features, photorealistic, 8k] [现代公寓: Modern apartment interior, cold color temperature, shadows, realism, indoor setting, blurred background, depth of field]
shots.dialogue: 李道玄：呼……我是不是太入戏了？居然对着一堆模型动了真气。
shots.audio_prompt: Medium shot, Li Daoxuan jerks his hand back violently, breathing heavily, chest rising and falling rapidly, camera handheld shake.

shots.prompt: 视角：近景。他举起右手，眉头紧锁，目光聚焦在食指指尖上。蓝色的屏幕光映在他侧脸。 重点：发现异常。 [李道玄: young Chinese man, tired expression, messy hair, casual home clothes, modern setting, cinematic lighting, blue screen light reflection on face, shocked expression, detailed facial features, photorealistic, 8k] [现代公寓: Modern apartment interior, cold color temperature, shadows, realism, indoor setting, blurred background, depth of field]
shots.dialogue: 李道玄：等等，刚才那种触感……那种阻力，不像是在弹空气啊。
shots.audio_prompt: Close up, holding hand up to face, eyes squinting to inspect, blue monitor light illuminating the side of his face, focus hunting.

shots.prompt: 视角：极特写。食指指腹上，清晰地印着一抹鲜红的血迹。血迹渗入指纹的纹路中，显得格外刺眼。 重点：虚构变为现实的证据。 [李道玄（手指）: extreme close-up of human finger, macro photography, fingerprint ridges, skin pores, realistic skin texture, giant scale, thumb and middle finger snapping gesture, blood stain on fingertip, high detail] [现代公寓: Modern apartment interior, cold color temperature, shadows, realism, indoor setting, blurred background, depth of field]
shots.dialogue: 李道玄：这是……红色的颜料？不对，这温热的感觉，还有这股铁锈味……
shots.audio_prompt: Macro extreme close-up, a smear of bright red blood clearly visible on the finger ridges, blood soaking into skin texture, sharp focus.

shots.prompt: 视角：正面大特写。李道玄的双眼圆睁，瞳孔收缩。恐惧与不可置信的神情爬满脸庞。背景完全黑暗，只有那一抹血红在指尖（虚焦）和眼中（聚焦）呼应。 重点：世界观崩塌的心理冲击。 [李道玄: young Chinese man, tired expression, messy hair, casual home clothes, modern setting, cinematic lighting, blue screen light reflection on face, shocked expression, detailed facial features, photorealistic, 8k] [现代公寓: Modern apartment interior, cold color temperature, shadows, realism, indoor setting, blurred background, depth of field]
shots.dialogue: 李道玄：这是……真的血？！
shots.audio_prompt: Frontal big close-up, Li Daoxuan's eyes wide open, pupils contract sharply (dolly zoom), expression of pure disbelief and terror, background fades to black.
